— Right-of-way, roundabouts, lanes, passing","learner_facing":true,"markdown":"## C — Right-of-way, roundabouts, lanes, passing

FACT_ID: sec07-F01 | anchor: FXsec07F01
Yield to pedestrians in marked crosswalks or at unmarked intersections. When joining a roadway from a private road or driveway, stop and give way to all traffic and pedestrians [FXsec07F01].
Source: [FXsec07F01 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0018]

FACT_ID: sec07-F02 | anchor: FXsec07F02
When making a left turn after checking that the way is clear, give way to traffic approaching from the opposite direction, including bicycles and pedestrians [FXsec07F02].
Source: [FXsec07F02 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0020]

FACT_ID: sec07-F03 | anchor: FXsec07F03
Before entering a roadway from a private road or driveway, stop and give way to every vehicle and pedestrian [FXsec07F03].
Source: [FXsec07F03 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0018]

FACT_ID: sec07-F04 | anchor: FXsec07F04
If vehicles reach an intersection without signs or signals at the same time, the driver on the left gives way to the driver on the right [FXsec07F04].
Source: [FXsec07F04 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0018]

FACT_ID: sec07-F05 | anchor: FXsec07F05
Give way to pedestrians and bicyclists crossing in a marked crosswalk or at an unmarked intersection. Red-light turns pose particular danger to pedestrians, so let them cross safely [FXsec07F05].
Source: [FXsec07F05 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0018]

FACT_ID: sec07-F06 | anchor: FXsec07F06
An emergency vehicle approaching from behind with a siren or flashing lights requires you to yield immediately, pull safely to the right edge and stop until it passes. Give way to funeral processions too [FXsec07F06].
Source: [FXsec07F06 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0018]

FACT_ID: sec07-F07 | anchor: FXsec07F07
Approach a stopped emergency vehicle or tow truck with flashing lights cautiously. Change to a nonadjacent lane when reasonable and safe for traffic conditions; if a safe lane change is unavailable, slow down and continue carefully [FXsec07F07].
Source: [FXsec07F07 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0018]

FACT_ID: sec07-F08 | anchor: FXsec07F08
Allow pedestrians and bicyclists to cross safely within marked crosswalks and at unmarked intersections by yielding to them [FXsec07F08].
Source: [FXsec07F08 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0018]

FACT_ID: sec07-F09 | anchor: FXsec07F09
Enter a roundabout by slowing, yielding to every circulating lane, circling counterclockwise around the island, and yielding to crossing pedestrians [FXsec07F09].
Source: [FXsec07F09 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0018]

FACT_ID: sec07-F10 | anchor: FXsec07F10
Once inside a roundabout, keep your lane until you are ready to leave, and show your intention with the right turn signal [FXsec07F10].
Source: [FXsec07F10 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0019]

FACT_ID: sec07-F11 | anchor: FXsec07F11
Before moving to another lane, inspect the side and rearview mirrors, signal your intention, and make a quick shoulder glance to check the blind spot just before moving [FXsec07F11].
Source: [FXsec07F11 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0019]

FACT_ID: sec07-F12 | anchor: FXsec07F12
After overtaking, move back to the right once your interior rearview mirror shows the front of the vehicle you passed [FXsec07F12].
Source: [FXsec07F12 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0019]

FACT_ID: sec07-F13 | anchor: FXsec07F13
Passing on hills or curves, or at intersections or railway crossings, is unlawful except on roads offering at least two traffic lanes going in the same direction [FXsec07F13].
Source: [FXsec07F13 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0019]

FACT_ID: sec07-F14 | anchor: FXsec07F14
Passing is forbidden when the line immediately to the left of your lane is solid [FXsec07F14].
Source: [FXsec07F14 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0020]
